caption: The drawing is composed predominantly in black and white, utilizing fine pointillism to depict a tall, ornate steeple that rises from the main structure of a building, likely a church. The steeple has a pointed, shingled roof with detailed texture, and an intricate metal finial with scrollwork at the very top. The left side of the composition features part of the building's façade, which includes sharply defined, arched windows with visible grilles or tracery, and sections of decorative stonework. Most of the background consists of an empty, lightly textured sky, emphasizing the vertical form of the steeple. The perspective is from a low angle, looking upward at the architecture, with the light source causing areas of shadow and contrast on the surfaces. The drawing is rendered in monochromatic tones, relying on varying density of dots for shading and form.
title: Wrought Iron Ornament
